BLS7: In worship, marriage and in the next world, such a soul-bride looks beautiful. ||1||Pause||

NBKU: As long as she lived with her father,
As long as she dwelt with her Father(Satguru),
ULXQ: her Husband wandered around in sadness.
so long did her spouse wander about very sad.
7K6C: I served and surrendered to the Lord, the True Being;
When I served and conciliated the True person,
Y54H: the Guru brought my bride to my home, and I obtained total happiness. ||2||
then the Guru brought the bride into my house and then, I obtained all happiness.
XDVZ: Her Husband, her Lord and Master, fulfills her heart's desires.
She fulfills the wishes of the heart of her Groom the Lord.
8ASJ: Hope and desire (my younger brother-in-law and sister-in-law) are now totally content. ||3||
She has soothed, in every way, her husband's younger brother's wife and her husband's elder brother's wife.
T7QR: She is the most noble of all the family.
In all the family she is the noblest.
YP9Q: She counsels and advises her hope and desire.
She is the counseller of her husband's younger brother and elder brother.
VDFW: How blessed is that household, in which she has appeared.
Blessed is the house, where-in she has appeared.
YK2S: O servant Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace and comfort. ||4||3||
O slave Nanak, she passes her time in perfect peace.
8ABM: Whatever I resolve, she does not allow it to come to pass.
The resolve, which I make, that the mammon allows not to mature.

To ward them off, she stands near goodness and self-mortification(self-control).
4J7R: She wears many disguises, and assumes many forms,
She wears many guises and assumes many forms.
6NE9: She has become the mistress of my home, and she does not allow me to live in it.
She has become the mistress of the house and lest me not to have a dwelling in it
QXSM: If I try, she fights with me. ||1||Pause||
If I make an effort to abide, she grapples with me. Pause.
SEE2: In the beginning, she was sent as a helper,
In the beginning she was sent by God as helper.
5UD6: but she has overwhelmed the nine continents, all places and interspaces.
But she has conquered the nine continents, all the places and inter spaces.

She has spared not, even the banks of streams, the sacred shrines, Yogis and ascetics.

They, who grow weary of reading Simirtis and studying Vedas, are under its sway.

Wherever I sit, there she sits with me.

Hugging me to Yours bosom, You savest me wherever I be.

Through the Guru, my gentle brother, friend and intercessor,

I have received the goods and my mind is rendered stable.

I have no fear of thieves of wind or of water.

Hear, you mates, my bridegroom has owned me.

Placing His hand on my forehead, he has protected me as His own. What do these ignorant people know? Pause.

as they think of doing evil to the innocent.

Realising the one Lord alone, my wandering has ceased and I now abides in an eternal place.

Yours saints are the saviours of the world and seeing their sight I remain stated.

that I may live beholding my Beloved, O my Mother?

Raiments, ornaments and very exquisite pleasures;

1H3U: and obedience of the whole world,

and jewel like beauteous home are of no avail.

76XQ: With foods and delicacies of so many different kinds,
Viands and victuals of many kinds,
SHQS: and such abundant pleasures and entertainments,

neither appease the soul, nor extinguish the desire.

Without meeting the Lord this day passes not.
KN7X: When the Lord is met, then, do I obtain all the comforts.
PEVC: By searching and seeking, I have heard this news,
By searching and, I have heard this news,
XLMA: that without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, no one swims across.
that sans the society of saints, none does swim across.

He, who has good destiny recorded on his forehead, meets the True Guru.
U8Z5: His hopes are fulfilled, and his mind is satisfied.
His hope is fulfilled, and his mind is sated.
88HE: When one meets God, then his thirst is quenched.
when the Lord is met, then is the thirst quenched.
ZZCM: Nanak has found the Lord, within his mind and body. ||4||11||
Nanak has found the Lord from within his mind and body.

XDC6: First, your social status is high.
6HPX: Second, you are honored in society.

O beauteous, good-featured, wiser and clever lady,

The dog of covetousness has ruined you in every way.

You wearest robes and enjoyest pleasures.
2N99: you practice good conduct to impress people;
To obtain honour among people you performest religious ceremonies.
4H70: you apply scented oils of sandalwood and musk,
You appliest to your body the perfume of aloe-wood and sandal,
H1VE: but your constant companion is the demon of anger. ||3||
but the pariah wrath is your evil companion.

Other creatures are yours water carriers.

In this world, yours is the sovereignty.

You have gold, silver and rupees.

But your lust has destroyed your good conduct.
MDG4: That soul, upon whom the Lord has bestowed His Glance of Grace,
The soul, on whom God, the King, casts His merciful glance,

Who by meeting the society of saints, obtains the Lord's Nectar,

fruitful is that body,. Says Nanak.
E9XD: All graces and all comforts shall come to you, as the happy soul-bride;

A6EP: you shall be supremely beautiful and wise. ||1||Second Pause||12||
Thus shall you be supremely beauteous and wise. Pause 2nd.

He who is seen physically alive, shall assuredly die.

He who is dead in life, shall remain eternal.

They who die while alive, through such a death they live eternally.

LHF2: The clay pot of the body shall be broken.

He who is rid of three qualities dwells in his own home.

He who climbs high, falls into the nether world.

He who lies low on the ground, him death touches not.

9RKK: This body and soul all belong to the Lord.

QVQ2: Remember your origins, O thoughtless fool.
Remember your origin O thoughtless fool.
W6EQ: Why are you so proud of yourself? ||1||Pause||
why are you proud of this much of yourself? Pause.
P3LJ: You are a guest, given three meals a day;
You are a guest of three seers of corn a day.
V91R: other things are entrusted to you. ||2||
Others goods are but a trust with you.
ML0N: you are just excrement, bones and blood, wrapped up in skin
You are ordure, bones and blood wrapped up in skin.
L1LR: - this is what you are taking such pride in! ||3||
It is on this that you are harbouring pride.
X791: If you could understand even one thing, then you would be pure.
If you understandest one Thing, then, alone you shall be pure.
DD3B: Without understanding, you shall be forever impure. ||4||
Without knowing the Lord, you shall ever be impure.
BXKV: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru.
L48A: through Him, I obtain the Lord, the All-knowing Primal Being. ||5||14||
Through whom, God, the Omniscient Lord is attained.
XPMU: One moment, one day, is for me many days.
One moment and one day of separation to me, is equal to many days.
1LTB: My mind cannot survive - how can I meet my Beloved? ||1||
My soul cannot live without Him. How should I meet my Beloved?
1AL0: I cannot endure one day, even one instant without Him.
An instant and a day, I can never pass without Him.

N8PD: The four watches of the day are like the four ages.
The four watches of the day are like the four ages.
LPSM: And when night comes, I think that it shall never end. ||2||
When the night comes, I think, then, that it shall never end.
N31N: The five demons have joined together, to separate me from my Husband Lord.
The five demons have jointly separated me, from my spouse.
DP00: Wandering and rambling, I cry out and wring my hands. ||3||
Wandering and wandering, I bewail and wring my hands.
FKU4: The Lord has revealed the Blessed Vision of His Darshan to servant Nanak;
To slave Nanak, God has shown His sight.

Realising his own self, he has obtained supreme bliss.
1XN3: In the Lord's service, are the greatest treasures.
In God's service are the richest treasures.

God's service results in having the Nectar-Name in one's mouth.
RM3N: The Lord is my Companion; He is with me, as my Help and Support.
God, my comrade and helper is with me.

In pain and pleasure, whenever I remember Him, He is present. Now, how can the poor Death's Courier terrify me? Pause.
UWN3: The Lord is my Support; the Lord is my Power.
God is my mainstay and God is my might.
QU2X: The Lord is my Friend; He is my mind's advisor. ||2||
God is my friend, and within my mind, is God's prop.
J646: The Lord is my capital; the Lord is my credit.
The Lord is my capital and the Lord is my credit.
2B7W: As Gurmukh, I earn the wealth, with the Lord as my Banker. ||3||
Through the Guru, I earn riches, the Lord is my Banker.
DPW9: By Guru's Grace, this wisdom has come.
By Guru's grace, this understanding is attained.
M048: Servant Nanak has merged into the Being of the Lord. ||4||16||
Slave Nanak has merged into the lap of the Lord.
DDEF: When God shows His Mercy, then this mind is focused on Him.
If the Lord becomes merciful, then is this soul fixed up in Him.
003J: Serving the True Guru, all rewards are obtained. ||1||
Serving the True Guru, I have received all the rewards.

My soul, why shouldest you feel sad when my True Guru is perfect.
0MYF: He is the Giver of blessings, the treasure of all comforts; His Ambrosial Pool of Nectar is always overflowing. ||1||Pause||
The Lord is the Grantor of boons, He is the treasure of all the comforts and His ambrosial tank is always brimful. Pause.
LLCM: One who enshrines His Lotus Feet within the heart,
He, who place in his heart God's lotus feet,
LVLT: meets the Beloved Lord; the Divine Light is revealed to him. ||2||
to him the Divine light is revealed and he meets, the Beloved Lord.
EMQC: The five companions have met together to sing the songs of joy.
Meeting together the five mates sing the songs of joy,
8947: The unstruck melody, the sound current of the Naad, vibrates and resounds. ||3||
and within him re-sounds the tune of the celestial strain.
YK05: O Nanak, when the Guru is totally pleased, one meets the Lord, the King.
Nanak, when the Guru is mightily pleased one meets with God, the Hari King.
83KU: Then, the night of one's life passes in peace and natural ease. ||4||17||
Thereafter the night passes in peace and poise.
LE7H: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has revealed Himself to me.
Showing His mercy, God has revealed Himself to me.
U9VQ: Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth. ||1||
Meeting the True Guru, I have received the perfect wealth.

For Yours slaves, that alone is the noblest advice, resolve and wisdom, which You doest or causes to be done. Pause.
UWZ3: Your Name is Ambrosial Nectar, O Beloved Lord; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained its sublime essence.
Nectar is Your Name, O my Beloved. In the society of saints I have attained its relish.
QR7B: Those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||2||
The mortals, who sing the praise of God, the Treasure of peace, become perfect and remains sated and satiated.
5GZT: One who has Your Support, O Lord Master, is not afflicted by anxiety.
He, who has Your support, 0 Lord; him anxiety touches not.
2WGA: One who is blessed by Your Kind Mercy, is the best, the most fortunate king. ||3||
He, on whom You showerest Your benediction; he is the Sublime and Fortunate banker.
JDGL: Doubt, attachment, and deceit have all disappeared, since I obtained the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
The doubts, worldly attachments and frauds are all gone since I had a vision of You.
0VG1: Dealing in the Naam, O Nanak, we become truthful, and in the Love of the Lord's Name, we are absorbed. ||4||1 | 40||
Nanak deals only in the True Name and he is absorbed in the love of God's Name.
UUJN: He washes off the filth of other peoples' incarnations, but he obtains the rewards of his own actions.
The slanderer washes the filth of many births of others and reaps the fruit of his own acts.
D5NJ: He has no peace in this world, and he has no place in the Court of the Lord. In the City of Death, he is tortured. ||1||
He has no peace here and no room in God's court. He is tormented in the city of death.
VSG1: The slanderer loses his life in vain.
The calumniator loses his life in vain.
NR0M: He cannot succeed in anything, and in the world hereafter, he finds no place at all. ||1||Pause||
He cannot succeed in anything and hereafter obtains not a place. Pause.
A1YK: Such is the fate of the wretched slanderer - what can the poor creature do?
Such is the fate of the wretched slander. What can the poor creature do?
CBJT: He is ruined there, where no one can protect him; with whom should he lodge his complaint? ||2||
He is ruined there where none can protect him. With whom should he lodge a complaint.
